composition_subtypes.role: Sort rings by outer radius (then inner, height) for non-increasing order.
Greedy stack-based selection processes rings descending to maximize height.

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort rings by outer radius, then greedily pick rings with stack enforcing inner radius constraint to maximize total height.
payload.rationale: Solution uses sorting to order rings and greedy stack algorithm for selection. Both are distinct mechanisms that together solve the problem.
